messages:
Priya (AM): Heads-up — Acme trial ran into an observability blocker during handoff.
Priya (AM): They can see our logs but can’t link them to traces in their APM. Also their Splunk drain is intermittently returning 403s.
Eli (SE): Can you drop a sample trace id and a raw log line? quick check: is the trace id in the log header or body?
Priya (AM): Sample log: \n  2026-02-10T18:12:03Z level=info msg=\"request end\" path=/v1/generate trace_id=0a1b2c3d4e5f6g user=acme-123\nTrace id present in the body but in traces the span shows no trace_id for that request.
Eli (SE): Ok — likely header mapping mismatch. Our collector sends both x-request-id and traceparent depending on client SDK. Do they expect a different header name? @Kai can you confirm our outgoing header mapping for the client-facing proxy?
Kai (SRE): We proxy the client request headers and set x-request-id if none provided. For OTEL we pass along the incoming traceparent as-is. If their app only looks at a custom header (e.g., X-ACME-TRACE) it won’t join.
Eli (SE): If trace id is only in log body, APM won’t auto-link. Two paths: 1) add a short log parser on their side that extracts trace_id from body and sets their span attribute; or 2) make our proxy inject a trace header matching their expectation.
Priya (AM): They said they don’t control the app easily but can map headers on their edge router. I asked them which header they accept.
observability-bot: Export job 3245 -> FAILED (403) to splunk-acme-ingest.prod (attempt 3)\nreason: invalid-api-token
Priya (AM): Splunk 403 is from their side or token rotation. They supplied a token that works in Splunk UI but fails via our drain.
Kai (SRE): Two quick checks: 1) Are we sending the token in Authorization: Splunk <token> or in header X-Splunk-Token? 2) We have a 10 req/s external drain throttle + retry/backoff. If token returns 403 we will not retry repeatedly, we surface the error.
Eli (SE): Our drain config (internal) looks like: \n```
drain_type: http
endpoint: https://splunk-acme-ingest.prod:8088
headers:
  Authorization: "Splunk <redacted>"
max_retries: 5
retry_backoff: exponential
rate_limit_per_customer: 10/s
buffering: enabled
```\nSuggest they test with curl to the same endpoint from their network and with the exact header we send.
Priya (AM): I sent them the curl command and asked them to confirm response. Also asked them to try the header as X-Splunk-Token since their proxy might rewrite Authorization.
Jordan (Eng): If they need higher drain throughput for the POC (bursting), we can temporarily raise the per-customer rate to 50/s for the next 48h. Need sales approval for sustained bump.
Priya (AM): They also asked about retention and cost during POC — 30d retention for logs would be helpful. Any quick answer on credits/retention?
Jordan (Eng): We can enable a 30d retention trial for two weeks; CS will note for billing. No charge change for POC window.
Eli (SE): Back to traces — assuming we can’t change app: we can configure our forwarder to copy trace_id into X-ACME-TRACE for outbound (if they want). That’s a low-risk per-customer mapping.
Priya (AM): They confirmed their edge accepts X-ACME-TRACE and can map to spans. Please add that option to their trial config.
Kai (SRE): I’ll flip a per-team mapping flag and kick off a redeploy to apply header-mapping. Expect rotation in ~15m. Also I’ll increase drain burst to 50/s for 2 days while they validate.
observability-bot: Export job 3250 -> SUCCESS to datadog-forwarder (latency 160ms)
Priya (AM): Security Q: acme wants confirmation we can use their KMS for log encryption in Private deployment. High level answer? They asked in the security questionnaire.
Jordan (Eng): For Private we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). For Hosted we offer bring-your-own-key for critical fields via integrations. I’ll paste the SOC2/KMS blurb into the questionnaire.
Priya (AM): Great — I updated the questionnaire and sent the curl test to the customer. Next steps: \n• Kai to apply header-mapping + temporary rate bump (in flight)\n• Jordan to enable 30d trial retention and update sec questionnaire\n• Eli to share a short how-to (curl + header examples)\n• Priya to run validation call 2026-02-10 21:00 UTC with acme
Eli (SE): I’ll post the curl snippets + sample response in #sales after the deploy.\nEli (SE): quick snippet for them to test: \n```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Splunk <their-token>" -H "X-Request-ID: 123" \
  https://splunk-acme-ingest.prod:8088/services/collector/event/1.0
```\nPriya (AM): Thanks — keeping this thread updated. :thumbsup:
